name: Ayagor
description: Ayagor, also called the Dragon's Bowl and Atarka's roost, is the high mountain valley where Atarka roosts and is fed.

summary.text: Ayagor, also called the Dragon's Bowl and Atarka's roost, is the high mountain valley where Atarka roosts and is fed.

bio.text: Ayagor is described as a narrow, shallow, high valley, like a dinner platter, where Atarka assembles her clan to feed her, and as a mountaintop stone bowl where she lounges and receives offerings.
In Khanfall, Yasova leads her warriors to Ayagor and feeds a mammoth to Atarka as a gift, asking to stop fighting.
She carves an ivory image of the Temur offering meat to Atarka and says the future is not yet written.

In The Call, Surrak delivers the offering to Atarka at the Ayagor with the traditional words, and when his second says Surrak killed one of her brood, Atarka says 'Take care of it' and Surrak defeats the second when he attacks with a knife.
Later Chronicle of Bolas stories mention it as a permanent encampment devoted to feeding Atarka, where meat is delivered to her and where she feasts and takes hunting fledglings.

status.text: As of the latest mention in Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire, it is the gathering place where Atarka feasts and takes hunting fledglings.

timeline.summary: Yasova leads her warriors to Ayagor and feeds a mammoth to Atarka as a gift, asking to stop fighting.
timeline.quote: I don't want to fight you anymore. I'm tired of fighting. That was a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

timeline.summary: Yasova carves an ivory image of the Temur offering meat to Atarka and says the future is not yet written.
timeline.quote: The future isn't yet written," she said. "It's up to us to write it, together.

timeline.summary: Surrak delivers the offering to Atarka at the Ayagor with the traditional words.
timeline.quote: Great Atarka, dragonlord and protector. This is a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

timeline.summary: Surrak's second tells Atarka that Surrak killed one of her brood; Atarka says 'Take care of it,' and Surrak defeats the second when he attacks with a knife.
timeline.quote: With a burst of speed, Surrak slammed his fist into his second's ribs, cracking several, and sending the knife clattering along the stone.
